notablePrerequisites: Zirilan of the Claw does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Zirilan by paying {1}{R}{R} and tapping it, searching your library for Worldgorger Dragon, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the batllefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
Cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and discarding your hand.
Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all permanents exiled by it to the battlefield.
